chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
When a child is born, the adhan should be recited in his right ear, and the iqamah in the left.
ai.seo_question: What should be recited in a newborn’s ears according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the practice of reciting the adhan in the newborn’s right ear and the iqamah in the left ear. It reflects an early introduction of the child to the symbols of salat (prayer) and the remembrance of Allah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.911 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"When a child is born, the adhan (call to prayer) should be recited in their right ear, and the iqamah (call to commence prayer) in their left ear."
